name: Hezron
title: Patriarch of the tribe of Judah
summary: Hezron was the son of Perez and grandson of Judah, one of Jacob's twelve sons. He is a significant figure in the lineage that leads from Abraham through Judah and onward to King David and finally to Jesus Christ. Although little is told about his personal life, he holds a prominent place in the biblical genealogies.

keyEvents.title: The Birth and Lineage of Hezron
keyEvents.description: Hezron was born as the son of Perez, who was the son of Judah and Tamar. He is counted among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Hezron is listed in the genealogy of Judah as an important patriarch. His descendants became a significant part of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Descendants of Hezron in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: 1 Chronicles provides a detailed overview of Hezron's descendants, including his sons Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb, who became founders of important families in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Hezron in the Genealogy of Ruth
keyEvents.description: In the Book of Ruth, Hezron is mentioned in the lineage from Perez to David, highlighting his role in the messianic line.

keyEvents.title: Hezron in Jesus' Genealogy in Matthew
keyEvents.description: In the Gospel of Matthew, Hezron is included in Jesus' genealogy, showing the direct line from Abraham through Judah and Perez to Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: Hezron in Jesus' Genealogy in Luke
keyEvents.description: Luke also includes Hezron in his genealogy of Jesus, confirming his place in salvation history.
